findings.body: The changed test still exercises `finalRetry`, while the unchanged `group-queue.ts:528-610` still counts failed turns, schedules an in-memory retry, and passes `finalRetry` to the processor. Failed turns also release their input for durable recovery (`group-processing-flow.ts:228-247` and `message-loop.ts:321-335`). T3 therefore leaves two retry owners, and a final local attempt can send a failure notice and keep input that should remain available to the next turn. Remove the queue retry path and update its tests to exercise durable recovery.
